tasks.title: Address translation simulator
tasks.statement: Compare shadow page tables and nested EPT/NPT on four workloads. Change the mode and the guest and host page sizes, and watch the two-dimensional walk on a TLB miss and the total cost in memory accesses. The exercise is solved when all four goals are met.
tasks.hint: A TLB entry covers a page of the smaller of the two sizes: a guest huge page is useless if the host pages are small.
